rationale: Adjudicate AI-positive on the official August 2024 announcement of an AI assistant integrated into Kalibrate Location Intelligence for retail, restaurant and healthcare real-estate decisions. This is product-family evidence plausibly matching the record's Kalibrate/TAS retail real-estate GIS, but does not prove TAS/KLI are the same offering or that the feature applied to the undated source-represented version. The blind proposal's direct KLI mapping and labeler's negative were both uncertain; best-supported call is weak/forced AI, not a confident transfer from another Kalibrate product. Kalibrate fuel-pricing AI is not applicable.
